constraints.source_text: An audition is required for admission.
It requires eight courses in six Core Literacies, plus two courses in Global Perspectives (which may double-count with courses in the Core Literacies) and two courses in writing.
constraints.description: General Education requires eight courses across six Core Literacies, two Global Perspectives courses (which may overlap with Core Literacies), and two writing courses.
constraints.note: No enumerated course list provided for Core Literacies, Global Perspectives, or writing categories; classified as Course Selection based on stated counts, but pool is undefined.

constraints.source_text: Select 4 units from the following list: THTR 105 Introduction to Screen Acting Units: 2 - THTR 250 Camera and Improvisation Units: 2 - THTR 305a Directing Units: 4 - THTR 309 Dramaturgy Units: 4 - THTR 343 Musical Theatre Audition Units: 3 - THTR 365 Playwriting I Units: 4 - THTR 416 Creating Content for the Actor Units: 2.0 - THTR 440 Advanced Voice: Voice-Over Acting Units: 2 - THTR 464 An Actor's Reel Units: 2

constraints.source_text: Complete the two required courses below. In addition, take one course from List A and one course from either List A or B. - THTR 125 Text Studies for Production Units: 4 - THTR 225g Theatre Across History and Cultures Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete THTR 125 and THTR 225g, plus one course from List A and one course from List A or List B.

unclassified.source_text: All BFA Theatre majors are required to earn a grade point average of 2.75 (A = 4.0) in their theatre courses each semester. BFA students who fail to earn a GPA of 2.75 in their theatre courses will be placed on probation the following semester. Students who remain on probation for a consecutive second semester will be disqualified from the BFA program.
unclassified.why: This is a GPA floor and its grade-based consequence, which the taxonomy explicitly marks as out of scope.

unclassified.source_text: A student disqualified from continued study in the BFA program for failing to meet the GPA standards outlined above will be given the option of transferring into the BA program.
unclassified.why: Describes a consequence/option tied to the out-of-scope GPA policy rather than a degree-plan requirement.

unclassified.source_text: In addition, all entering freshmen are expected to complete a General Education Seminar during their first year at USC.
unclassified.why: Phrased as an expectation ('expected to complete'), which reads as advisory rather than a binding requirement.

unclassified.source_text: Note that courses within the major will also satisfy certain Core Literacy requirements. Please work with your major adviser to determine those courses.
unclassified.why: Advisory guidance directing students to consult an adviser, not itself a constraint.
